title: Python, Re-Skinned, Keeping the Steal: Braodo's Latest Python Loader and Obfuscation
description: Attackers have evolved the Braodo Stealer campaign to use sophisticated obfuscation techniques and GitHub-hosted payloads. The malware employs varied social-engineering lures themed around travel, medical records, weddings, and automotive topics. The loader uses batch scripts with large junk-code blocks and modified ABOBUS obfuscation to evade detection. Braodo delivers self-contained Python packages including the runtime and dependencies from GitHub repositories, then executes bytecode payloads. The stealer harvests browser credentials, cookies, payment information, and Facebook Meta advertising account data from multiple browsers. Stolen data is exfiltrated through Telegram Bot API. The malware establishes persistence via startup folder entries, terminates browser processes to access locked databases, impersonates lsass.exe for elevated privileges, and uses DLL injection with named pipes for decryption operations.
